items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I told my friend, who died, (?) Phillips... He had a little band around here and I played with him.

ctx.x: all right with me. I told my friend, who died, (?) Phillips... He had a little band around here and I played with him. We played a whole lot of good jobs and everything. He'd go down there and run the service down in the church. He belonged there too. He's a big deacon there. So he tried to get me there. I said, 'Well, you get somebody to play bass(?). I don't believe in no horn being in church."
